layers.title: Intro
layers.description: What the repository makes and how a page becomes an MP4.

layers.title: Use cases
layers.description: Start from a familiar video format and replace its copy, data or brand.

layers.title: Demo films
layers.description: Finished pieces that combine several effects around one subject or story.

layers.title: Comparisons
layers.description: The same input under different treatments, for choosing an effect.

layers.title: Effect films
layers.description: Full renders of one effect; each also plays inside its effect card.

films.title: Intro
films.summary: A guided overview that deliberately repeats selected uses and techniques.

card.headline: Intro
card.description: Four uses, a voiced character, an effect montage and three short stories, then a word edit and an MP4 export.
card.useFor: Seeing what the repository makes before choosing an example.
card.relation: It repeats selected use cases and effects; each has its own film below.

films.audience: First-time visitors deciding whether the repository fits their work.

films.title: Social clips
films.summary: Hook, interaction and call to action.

card.headline: Social clips
card.description: A hook, a booking interaction and a closing call to action in a vertical social ad.
card.useFor: Reels, announcements and short campaigns.
card.relation: Product demos below use the same app in a closer walkthrough.

films.audience: Small businesses and creators posting short vertical promos.

films.title: Product demos
films.summary: One interface interaction, explained.

card.headline: Product demos
card.description: Follow a cursor into a booking screen and watch one tap change its state.
card.useFor: Feature walkthroughs and interface launches.
card.relation: A focused interaction example, rather than another effect family.

films.audience: App and software teams announcing a feature.

films.title: Infographics
films.summary: Turn figures into a data story.

card.headline: Infographics
card.description: Numbers build into bars, a share-of-total ring and an hourly trend.
card.useFor: Reports, explainers and data stories.
card.relation: Sample figures; replace the data and labels together.

films.audience: Teams turning a report or a year of figures into a short video.

films.title: Animated backgrounds
films.summary: Three reusable background loops.

card.headline: Animated backgrounds
card.description: Three four-second loops: a flowing gradient, moving ridgelines and a particle network.
card.useFor: Title backgrounds, transitions and supporting footage.
card.relation: Each source loop is seamless; the comparison film cuts between them.

films.audience: Editors who need looping backgrounds under titles, interviews or streams.

films.title: One flight. Twenty worlds.
films.summary: One character travels through twenty art directions.

card.headline: One flight. Twenty worlds.
card.description: One courier travels through twenty artworks while its flight and cape remain continuous.
card.useFor: Character-led journeys and transitions between visual worlds.
card.relation: Flight, cape motion and camera movement stay continuous across changing artwork.

films.audience: Brand and title designers planning a sequence across visual styles.

films.title: The Final Final
films.summary: A two-character conversation with speech, gestures, reaction holds and a closing joke.

card.headline: The Final Final
card.description: Mira asks for the launch video. Pip has made one small, dramatic improvement.
card.useFor: Voiced character stories, product explainers and comedy shorts.
card.relation: Speech mouth cues, expressive hands, listening reactions and deliberate camera cuts share one timeline.

films.audience: Explainer, comedy and product-story makers who need talking characters.

films.title: One drop. Many forms.
films.summary: Authored drop, splash, morph and underwater chapters.

card.headline: One drop. Many forms.
card.description: A drop becomes a crown, changing glass shapes and a dive below the surface.
card.useFor: Material-led title sequences and transitions between scenes.
card.relation: Choreographed surfaces and shape changes; the separate liquid studies demonstrate baked fluid motion.

films.audience: Designers of material-led openers, product ads and transitions.

films.title: One dot. Many roles.
films.summary: One orange dot becomes a switch, a letter, a spring trace and a reveal before returning to the start.

card.headline: One dot. Many roles.
card.description: A visual cue connects type, timing, depth and a reveal; closes its loop.
card.useFor: Brand loops, logo openers and identity motion.
card.relation: Each role is a reusable effect: letter reflow, spring response, spatial type and dot reveal.

films.audience: Brand-motion designers building a short identity loop.

films.title: One word. Many forms.
films.summary: A word changes form and returns to a readable title.

card.headline: One word. Many forms.
card.description: A replaceable CJK title passes through solid, particle, contour and signal treatments.
card.useFor: Title sequences and logo stings.
card.relation: The solid, contour and glitch chapters reuse library effects; the particle chapters are authored in the film.

films.audience: Creators who need a title or logo sting, including CJK lettering.
films.plan: D2 and D11: rebuilt as three six-second title presets with a short hook and a readable hold.

films.title: COUNTERFORM
films.summary: A complete fight with authored action and contact timing.

card.headline: COUNTERFORM
card.description: Original action choreography, contact holds and framing.
card.useFor: Action promos, game trailers and sports intros.
card.relation: Same fight. Eight treatments. reuses this choreography to compare operations.

films.audience: Action, game and sports promo makers.

films.title: Same fight. Eight treatments.
films.summary: Compare eight operations on the same choreography.

card.headline: Same fight. Eight treatments.
card.description: A common source makes eight different operations comparable.
card.useFor: Choosing a treatment for moving footage.
card.relation: COUNTERFORM uses the same choreography as a finished sequence.

films.audience: Anyone choosing a treatment for moving footage.

films.title: One scene. Many eras.
films.summary: The same room/action under eight art treatments.

card.headline: One scene. Many eras.
card.description: One continuous cup-lifting action, eight room treatments and stable scene landmarks.
card.useFor: Comparing illustration and period styles on one scene.
card.relation: The scene is also a reusable preset in the effect library.

films.audience: Art directors comparing period or illustration styles on one scene.

films.title: Find the Form
films.summary: An extended rendered example of volumetric smoke.

card.headline: Find the Form
card.description: Inspect baked volumetric smoke around lettering.
card.useFor: Title reveals and atmospheric logo stings.
card.relation: Baked in Blender; playback does not need Blender.

films.audience: Designers of title reveals and atmospheric logo stings.

films.title: Overflow
films.summary: Partly filled bowl → rising water → overflow → settling.

card.headline: Overflow
card.description: Inspect filling, spill and drainage of a partly filled bowl.
card.useFor: Drink and product shots with liquid motion.
card.relation: Baked in Blender; Slow Gold is its viscous variant.

films.audience: Product and drink ad makers who need liquid motion.

films.title: Slow Gold
films.summary: Inspect liquid contact, stretching and drainage over a ring.

card.headline: Slow Gold
card.description: A moving golden stream lays a viscous sheet over a dark ceramic ring, stretches and drains onto its plinth.
card.useFor: Product ads with thick, slow liquid.
card.relation: A viscosity variant of the liquid-flow effect; baked in Blender.

films.audience: Product ad makers who need thick, slow liquid.

films.title: One block. A drawn city.
films.summary: Surface hatching, staged construction and camera travel in one scene.

card.headline: One block. A drawn city.
card.description: Hatching is anchored in object coordinates. Camera movement preserves the marks, while changing light changes ink density.
card.useFor: Architectural and illustrated 3D scenes.
card.relation: The full render of the surface-hatching effect.

films.audience: Illustrators and architects presenting a drawn 3D scene.

films.title: One light. Different edges.
films.summary: Inspect source size and object height against the shadow.

card.headline: One light. Different edges.
card.description: Widen a light source or raise a sphere to change the softness and spread of its shadow.
card.useFor: Tuning product and 3D lighting.
card.relation: The soft-shadow effect card keeps its own loop.

films.audience: Product and 3D designers tuning lighting.
films.retire: D2: no new render; the soft-shadow effect card keeps its loop.
films.plan: Soft shadows are to appear in a product spotlight use case instead.

films.title: Six optical treatments
films.summary: Six independent looks for choosing a treatment.

card.headline: Six optical treatments
card.description: Moiré, slit-scan type, a paper ribbon, caustic light, holographic foil and a path morph, three seconds each.
card.useFor: Choosing an optical look for a title or background.
card.relation: Each three-second segment plays inside its own effect card.

films.audience: Designers choosing an optical look for a title or background.

films.title: Image distortion, collisions and particles
films.summary: Three unrelated operations with separate settings.

card.headline: Image distortion, collisions and particles
card.description: A PixiJS liquid poster, a Rapier domino chain and WebGPU orbital particles, each with its own settings.
card.useFor: Seeing what each rendering library adds.
card.relation: Each segment plays inside its own effect card.

films.audience: Developers choosing between PixiJS, Rapier and WebGPU effects.

films.title: Pulse / Form
films.summary: Measured audio changes solid image-cell depth.

card.headline: Pulse / Form
card.description: Measured sound energy and frequency bands give image cells depth.
card.useFor: Music visuals and sound-reactive posts.
card.relation: A variant of the image-relief effect.

films.audience: Musicians and podcasters making sound-reactive visuals.

films.title: Motion / Release
films.summary: Measured image movement emits and directs fragments.

card.headline: Motion / Release
card.description: Measured image movement releases solid fragments from faster regions.
card.useFor: Action edits and kinetic transitions.
card.relation: The full render of the motion-driven fragments effect.

films.audience: Editors adding energy to action footage.

films.title: Impact / Orbit
films.summary: A measured score attack cues an authored held 3D pose and animated lighting.

card.headline: Impact / Orbit
card.description: Music attacks cue authored held poses; camera and lights keep moving around real 3D geometry.
card.useFor: A bullet-time beat inside an action edit.
card.relation: A variant of the freeze-orbit effect.

films.audience: Action and sports editors who want a bullet-time beat.
films.plan: D2: COUNTERFORM gains a 1.2 s freeze-orbit beat; this entry is removed after that render.

films.title: Say it. Mean it.
films.summary: Recorded speech, expressive mouth shapes and authored gestures.

card.headline: Say it. Mean it.
card.description: Speech mouth shapes and facial performance in close-up.
card.useFor: Talking-character clips and explainers.
card.relation: The Final Final uses the same speech and expression rig.

films.audience: Makers of talking-character clips and explainers.
